transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net, my name is Callie. How can I help today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi. I ordered a new phone on your website a week ago, a Pixel 9, order number S N O 8 8 1 4, and it still hasn't arrived. It's a bit frustrating.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm sorry it's taken so long, Noor, that is frustrating when you're waiting on a new phone. Can I take your PIN to look at the account?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks. So you ordered a phone a week ago and it hasn't been delivered yet. Is that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What's the order number?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: S N O 8 8 1 4, I said it at the start.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks. And which phone was it you ordered?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: A Pixel 9.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay. Was there a delivery date on the confirmation email?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It said the twelfth, which was Monday.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Can you read me the order number again so I can check it's the right one?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: S N O 8 8 1 4. Again.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Got it. The parcel is held at the courier depot because the address label was damaged. I've arranged redelivery for tomorrow, with a text the night before.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, good.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Have you received the redelivery text with the time slot?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it's come through. Tomorrow between ten and two.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great, so the phone is booked for delivery tomorrow. Is everything sorted for you now, Noor?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, thanks.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net, have a good day.
